messages:
Maya (eng-platform): quick check — Optimize toolkit final-mile. Milestones: code freeze Wed, QA Thu, rollout Fri. Who's owning quant recs / batching/caching / regression alerts? callouts to owners + blockers please.

Alex (eng-ml): I can own quant recommendations. PR #452 is out for review. Need perf numbers on quant-8 vs q4 before freeze. pinging @Jin K. for benchmarks.

Jin K.: on it, running matrix on T4 + A100. ETA end of day tomorrow. found one quant reg with long-tail failure on long prompts, will add repro.

Samir R.: I'll take batching/caching config. Plan: default batch_size=8, dynamic batching on 4s window, prefix caching enabled for chat. Will post config in repo. question: allow burst_bypass for low-latency tier?

Samir R.: config snippet:
```
batch_size: 8
dynamic_batch_window_ms: 50
prefix_caching: true
burst_bypass: enterprise
```

Maya (eng-platform): allow burst_bypass = true for enterprise tier only. Document the behavior in rollout notes.

Nadia S. (QA): we saw a subtle regression in generated token rates after previous quant PR. Saving eval set as: `eval/toolkit/regression_prompts.json`. Will run nightly and flag deltas > 2%.

Alex (eng-ml): noted. I added a canary flag: `--quant-canary` to gate rollout. Recommend canary on 10% traffic for 24h.

Samir R.: CR pinged @Maya for approval on autoscale policy change (PR #460). Short change to allow burst nodes for enterprise. @deploy-bot can we schedule a preflight tomorrow 09:30 UTC?

deploy-bot: Preflight job scheduled: `preflight-2034567890` — 2026-04-02 09:30 UTC. Logs will be posted to #eng-runtime.

Maya (eng-platform): action items: (1) Alex — finish perf table + repro by EOD tomorrow (2) Jin — attach benchmark logs (3) Samir — push batching config PR and add rollout notes (4) Nadia — run nightly eval and share baseline results. I'll consolidate and send to shiproom. Thanks :thumbsup:

Alex (eng-ml): ACK, will also drop a short note about expected cost delta.

Jin K.: ACK. will include raw latency p99 and token throughput.

Samir R.: ACK, aiming for PR today.

Nadia S.: ACK — will share failing case list as well.

Maya (eng-platform): cool. If anyone hits blockers ping me directly. Closing thread once PRs are up.
